payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_constant_mutants.py::test_only_a_constant_the_diff_writes_and_a_witness_names_is_mutated stayed green with the spec's wrong version 'A per-line matcher runs each pattern over one line at a time.' applied to saffron/gates/core/witness.py as an edit. The claim was "With the notes' patterns verbatim, `constant_mutants` derives one criterion for each pair of a constant and a witness. It applies `witness_name` to a witness id with `re.search`, and each constant pattern with `re.finditer` over each hunk's new side, the context and added lines joined. The constant is one the diff adds, or one whose line the diff changes, in a file outside the given test paths. The witness's own text in the diff names the constant as a whole word. Each of these derives nothing. A constant only on a context line. A constant in a test path. A name that is only the prefix of a longer one, as `NEW` of `NEWER`. A name that is only the suffix of a longer one, as `NEW` of `OLD_NEW`. A test in the same file whose own text never names it. A witness id the `witness_name` pattern does not match. A second criterion naming a witness already paired with that constant.", and only that witness ran under the edit.
